llm_response.reason: The website mimics the branding and content of a legitimate e-commerce platform (Lazada) while being hosted on an unrelated, newly-registered, crypto-themed domain. It displays unusually deep discounts, vague and mixed product categories, urgency tactics, and contact info lacking legitimacy. The content also attempts to lure users via both online shopping and crypto/investment hooks, contains keyword stuffing to attract multiple scam targets, and has no verifiable business information. Multiple hallmark characteristics of scam websites are present.
